g.title: GhidraDecisionTree
g.text: Primary Reviewer: GhidorahRex | Contractor Lead: ryankurtz
Operational Focus: USG Contractual Compliance & Decompiler Architecture Alignment

g.title: gate1
g.text: Does review risk public disclosure of unreleased

g.title: scrub
g.text: - Scrub draft comments of internal USG roadmap references
- Frame all feedback strictly on SLEIGH & SRE technical metrics

g.title: gate2
g.text: into Scalar vs Vector feature sets?

g.title: split_pr
g.text: Separate Bitmanip & Scalar Crypto from RVV

g.title: gate3
g.text: Does the RVV dynamic state (vtype, vl) conflict
with pending USG decompiler vector policy?

g.title: fast_track
g.text: Direct p-code mapping; zero architectural risk

g.title: merge_scalar
g.text: (Immediate value to community with zero policy conflict)

g.title: eval_encap
g.text: Can vector semantics be isolated via userops &
modular .sinc files without locking decompiler IR?

g.title: defer_eval
g.text: Frame deferral around general SIMD unification (ARM SVE / RVV)

g.title: strategic_hold
g.text: Host in experimental/riscv-vector branch; hold master
merge until internal USG policy release is finalized

g.title: public_defer
g.text: Post technical response on PR #5778 deferring RVV integration

text.tspan: This is not derived from any private Government
